title: Measure a text field
summary: COBOL: Measure a text field. Make PET four characters long.
introduction: LENGTH gives the declared length of this text field, including any spaces.
learningObjectives: Measure a text field with COBOL

blocks.text: Install GnuCOBOL. Save each example as lesson.cob, run cobc -x -free lesson.cob -o lesson, then run the program.

blocks.title: Measure a text field
blocks.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PET PIC X(3) VALUE "cat".
01 SIZE-NUM PIC 9.
procedure division.
COMPUTE SIZE-NUM = FUNCTION LENGTH(PET)
DISPLAY SIZE-NUM
stop run.

blocks.text: LENGTH measures the declared three-character size of PET.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Field length includes padding spaces; it is not always the typed word length.
